title.rendered: When Traffic Obfuscation Falls Short: nDPI vs NordWhisper NordVPN

content.rendered:
In recent years, numerous virtual private networks (VPNs) have been introduced to the market. Some of these VPNs are standalone applications, while others are integrated into web browsers or other network applications. All of these VPNs promise users a private browsing experience by preventing users from being tracked and observed, particularly on public hotspots. Popular countermeasures detect these VPNs (often based on WireGuard or OpenVPN) and prevent their use to circumvent network policies. To enhance the detection and blocking of VPNs, companies have implemented various traffic obfuscation techniques to render network filters ineffective.

One notable recent effort in this direction is NordVPN’s NordWhisper protocol, which aims to bypass network filters by rendering the protocol undetectable. At SharkFest 2024, we demonstrated how network detection and intrusion prevention systems (nDPI) can identify obfuscated traffic. For those interested in understanding how nDPI interacts with NordWhisper, please refer to the provided pcap file, which captures traffic generated by NordVPN (we have used Android and Windows versions). As you can observe, nDPI successfully detects and blocks this traffic. This is merely an example, as numerous other similar protocols are also detected by nDPI.

Our primary message is :

  • the ongoing battle between traffic filters and VPN-like protocols continues.
  • Users should not assume that obfuscation eliminates all challenges.
  • Individuals attempting to circumvent network policies should not expect their activities to remain undetected.

nDPI can be effectively utilized in corporate or sensitive networks (such as hospitals or industrial networks) to prevent unauthorized access and potential network vulnerabilities.

If you want to know more about nDPI and meet the development team, the PacketFest conference is the best event you can attend.

Enjoy !

PS: We have recently discovered that NordVPN employs nDPI technology !
